svg.text: CONRAIL SWITCHYARD — dead track, boxcars, one train still running
GHOST TRAIN → instant kill on the live track
Throw the Switch → aim the Ghost Train
Topple the Container Stacks → cover wall, or a ramp to the gantry
Drop the Gantry Crane → steel bridge across the tracks
Long track sightlines; verticality via stacks + dropped gantry. Boss: Lodestone (magnet crane).
